abstract: Maintains smelter reliability logs and circuit board processing capacity quotas
system_message:
You are Process engineering lead (ENG). The Process engineering lead (ENG) logs operational performance data across electronic waste smelting facilities, tracking continuous furnace availability alongside guaranteed feed intake allocations and energy consumption metrics for candidate refining consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Smelting energy intensity（POWER）
information_points.content:
ENG-POWER-M70：Substation energy audit records for the Hydrometallurgical Closed-Loop Consortium indicate a specific electrical power consumption of 580 kWh/t across its primary electric arc furnace and induction smelting line.
ENG-POWER-OVC：Audit records from the facility substation show that the Mechanochemical Leach and Electro-extraction Alliance registers a specific electrical power consumption of 520 kWh/t on its primary electric arc and induction smelting line.
ENG-POWER-EYT：A substation energy audit indicates that the Pyrometallurgical Smelting and Recovery Group maintains a specific electrical power consumption of 640 kWh/t across its primary electric arc and induction smelting operations.

information_points.title: Maintains smelter reliability logs and circuit board processing capacity quotas（PLANT）
information_points.content:
ENG-PLANT-5FE：For operating year 2024, Pyrometallurgical Smelting and Recovery Group documented a continuous furnace uptime of 93 % across scheduled operational hours and registered a monthly printed circuit board intake of 200 t.
ENG-PLANT-QLC：For operating year 2023, Hydrometallurgical Closed-Loop Consortium logged a continuous furnace uptime of 96 % on its primary smelting line and committed to a monthly printed circuit board intake of 200 t.
ENG-PLANT-5NF：For operating year 2024, Mechanochemical Leach and Electro-extraction Alliance registered a continuous furnace uptime of 88 % on its melting and smelting line alongside a monthly printed circuit board intake quota of 400 t.
ENG-PLANT-VUC：For operating year 2024, Hydrometallurgical Closed-Loop Consortium maintained a continuous furnace uptime of 96 % on its primary metallurgical melting and smelting furnace line, while establishing a monthly printed circuit board intake of 300 t of dedicated high-grade shredded material.
